_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 25: July 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that what you see is fake, and says he sees Black Friday, around November, and that it is fake.
mentions.quote: Friday. And it it's it's around November. is the Black Friday. It's in It's fake
mentions.falsify_match: A November 2025 market or retail event later judged illusory, or a crash on a Black Friday.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats ride the wave and that a wave does not last forever, says the Lord calls it a wave already starting to be at its breaking point, and that he sees it in the winter.
mentions.quote: to be at its breaking point. And I see it and it's in the winter
mentions.falsify_match: The run breaking over the 2025-26 winter.

mentions.claim_text: He opens saying the last video was heavy, thanks people for sticking through it and praying, and notes people asking what he saw.
mentions.quote: that last video was pretty heavy, wasn't it?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the February word that in the days ahead they would lay a foundation, and that what seems like the wild west now will become stability.
mentions.quote: what seems like the wild wild west right now will become stability
mentions.falsify_match: Regulatory settlement bringing stability to the sector.

mentions.claim_text: He locates a place about fifteen or twenty miles from Guthrie as the site where he saw people gathered around a temple worshipping the antichrist on Fridays.
mentions.quote: 20 miles from Guthrie from the major place that I saw all the people gathered
mentions.falsify_match: A large non-Christian temple built near Guthrie, Oklahoma with Friday worship.

mentions.claim_text: He ties the first frost to September being a time to remember, with a great acceleration starting from Rosh Hashanah to Rosh Hashanah and the birthing pains increasing to a point people are not ready for.
mentions.quote: September will be a time to remember for great change a great acceleration
mentions.falsify_match: A visible acceleration across that year.

mentions.claim_text: He makes clear it is not 2025 but 2027 he was looking into, where something tries to mess with the economy, seen with China and with rats using things, and starting in Europe.
mentions.quote: I saw it with China with rats using things and it started in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A rodent borne outbreak beginning in Europe with a Chinese origin, damaging the economy, in 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as they interceded for the nation he could see the darkness lift above the trees, that it will take a praying president in these last days, and that the Lord told him he would be thankful.
mentions.quote: I saw the the darkness lift above the trees
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: darkness lifting has no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts being asked by another seer when he thinks it will be, within the next five years, and answers with what he has seen and what they are praying for.
mentions.quote: before the next five year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a conversation about timing rather than a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if Christ came back right now billions of people would go to hell, so they must have a harvest of souls, leaving the ninety nine and going after the one.
mentions.quote: if he comes back right now, there will be billions of people go to hell
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the theological reason the delay keeps being extended.

mentions.claim_text: He reports a warning that staying out of sync brings great missed opportunities through 2025 and 2026, and says he saw clear into May of 2026 a shifting and a global realignment around the tariffs.
mentions.quote: clear into May of 2026 a shifting and and in and a a global realignment
mentions.condition_text: the opportunities depend on staying in sync
mentions.falsify_match: A global trade realignment landing by May 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is still watching Cuba and Ukraine, and repeats that a great shaking of the finances will happen.
mentions.quote: I'm still watching Cuba. I'm still watching what happens with Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: A financial shaking alongside developments in Cuba and Ukraine.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions the October prayer conference in the Ozarks being only about three months away, counting August, September and October.
mentions.quote: there's a prayer conference coming again in October
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event promotion.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being told to remember the sunflowers and the yellow flowers throughout the pasture, and reasons that sunflowers come out in September in America, so that dates it.
mentions.quote: remember the flowers remember the sunflowers. That's usually what happens in September
mentions.falsify_match: The seasonal reasoning is his own, the same method that dated Las Vegas and the Macy's scene.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees August and September again and hears the sound of an abundance of rain, and tells people believing only for enough to barely get by that it is time to believe for bigger.
mentions.quote: I hear the sound of an abundance of rain
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private provision with a belief condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says God loves sports and to believe him for the good seats, mentioning season tickets to the Thunder and the Dallas Cowboys, and that whatever your heart's desire is applies.
mentions.quote: I've got t season tickets to the Thunder next year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private desires with a belief condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch the month of September because it is a time to remember, and that he sees scales balancing out and things transferring.
mentions.quote: I see scales that are balancing out. I see scales and things transferring
mentions.falsify_match: A transfer of wealth or power visible in September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is seeing into November and December and sees a rocket ship taking off, then multiple things taking off, with change on change.
mentions.quote: I see a rocket ship taking off. I see the rocket ships taking off
mentions.falsify_match: A sharp market rise across November and December 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says great change is coming in 2026 and yet to come, and that 2026 will be trying to be the year of fix because they will try to fix it and mess with it.
mentions.quote: 2026 will be trying to be the year of fix. They'll try to fix it
mentions.falsify_match: A rigged or heavily managed 2026.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he says he is seeing 2028 in bold, repeating the year.
mentions.quote: I'm seeing 2028 in bold. I see 2028
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as given: a year with no content attached.

mentions.claim_text: He moves through 2028 and 2027, becomes visibly distressed and says he could throw up, repeating that he sees the rats and calling people to pray.
mentions.quote: 2028. 2027. 2027. Oh, the rats. The rats. I see the rats
mentions.falsify_match: A rodent borne plague in 2027 or 2028.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a window of opportunity for the church to rise up before the tribulation, asks whether they will put their head in the sand, and reports being told many false prophets are coming.
mentions.quote: Many false prophets are co
mentions.condition_text: the window depends on whether the church uses it
mentions.falsify_match: A proliferation of prophetic voices, which he elsewhere tells his audience to guard against.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether it is a three year window into 2028 or 2029, tied to what he just saw of the plague, the darkness and the revival, and says everything is about to change.
mentions.quote: of a three-year window into 2028, 2029?
mentions.falsify_match: The window closing at one of the two dates.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither, though offering both makes it hard to miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says those riding the fence and living halfway in and halfway out feel it is fine but will be picked off by the enemy because they are not under the blood and not pleading it.
mentions.quote: they're going to be picked off by the enemy because they're not underneath the blood
mentions.condition_text: protection conditioned on pleading the blood
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: any harm to a believer is attributable to not pleading the blood.

mentions.claim_text: He reports a word that the weather will get out of control, says he does not know whether it is done with satellites or some instrumentation, and that what he saw is more than cloud seeding.
mentions.quote: for the weather for it will get out of control
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of deliberate large scale weather manipulation beyond seeding.

mentions.claim_text: He returns to Rosh Hashanah and Adam's lease, saying that last Rosh Hashanah he was told things would accelerate and that Adam's lease is coming up, and that they do not see any kind of change like what is happening now.
mentions.quote: Last roash he said things would accelerate but Adam's lease he said is coming up
mentions.falsify_match: The transition he calls Adam's lease occurring at a Rosh Hashanah.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what is causing the disturbance to the earth's surface and answers a binary system, saying he has warned about a major binary system that another pastor was also talking about.
mentions.quote: I've warned you about a major bioner system
mentions.falsify_match: Discovery of a second solar companion affecting the earth, which current astronomy excludes.
